sn22.68:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.68:1.3: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu …pe… pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.68:1.4: yo kho bhikkhu, anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo’ti.
sn22.68:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī’ti?
sn22.68:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante, anattā, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:2.6: viññāṇaṃ anattā, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:2.7: imassa kho’haṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī’ti.
sn22.68:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.68:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu, anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:3.7: viññāṇaṃ anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:3.8: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo’ti. atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā …pe…
sn22.68:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
